name: PR Storyboard
author: GitEase
description: Turn your branch into a scrubbable story of intent, then draft and open a PR from that story.
long_description: PR Storyboard shows commits ahead of your base as ordered frames — title, heat, and key paths — so you can scrub the story of the branch before sharing. Generate a PR title and body from the frames and create the pull request with gh.
install_guide: Open a repository with commits on a feature branch. Open Storyboard from the navigation rail. Pick a base if needed, scrub frames, then Create PR.

features.title: Commit storyboard
features.description: Horizontal frames for each commit (or clustered group) with +/- heat.

features.title: Smart clustering
features.description: Merge consecutive commits that share a conventional type or top-level path.

features.title: PR draft
features.description: Title and Markdown body derived from frames; create with gh pr create.

notes: Storyboard strip, clustering, and gh PR create.
